notes.title: Update 0.19.0 - Nutrients Part 1
notes.notes:
[b]The first part of the big nutrient update is here.[/b]

- An NPK fertilizer ratio was added for hydro systems.
- Several new textures have been added for all plants. 
- Male cannabis plants can now be harvested to obtain pollen, which in turn can be used for pollination.

notes.title: Update 0.18.3
notes.notes:
- New plant models with 3D buds have been added.
- DLSS and FSR3 have been added
- Bug fix: Mother plants now have an 18h rhythm.
- New Item: A plant protection for outdoor plants has been added. It protects the plant from low and high temperatures.
- Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.18.2
notes.notes:
- The 18/12 hour cycle of the plants has been added. 18 hours for growth and 12 hours for flowering. This must be changed when repotting, unless you have an employed gardener.
- The water tank can now be rinsed if too much fertilizer has been applied. Over-fertilizing damages the plant.
- An animation error of the Venilator when opening a grow box has been fixed.
- The bug that it rains in buildings when loading the game has been fixed.
- Added the possibility to display the number of objects in the entire game area in the FPS display. (More than 2000 objects can lead to performance problems. All objects that can be picked up in the world are counted. This also includes buds that are dropped during harvesting because the inventory is full.)
- Some objects have been optimized to avoid performance problems when a large number of objects are placed.
- Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.18.1
notes.notes:
- An error when placing the pollinator L and trimmer L has been fixed.

- Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.18.0
notes.notes:
- Unity Engine update.
- A casino with various games and slots has been added.
- All sound settings have been revised.
- Stereo audio, HTRF binaural audio (Steam audio), reflection and pathing can be selected.
- The sky, clouds and atmosphere have been revised.
- Sunshafts have been added.
- Fixed minor bugs.

[b]Attention:[/b]
It cannot be guaranteed that all changes will work directly on all systems. You can play the previous version until the new improvements run on every system. To do this, go to the game's properties in Steam, click on Betas and select a version.
